license_note: The repository LICENSE file is the unmodified Apache License 2.0 text and governs the published weights, tokenizer, and chat template. A separate USAGE_POLICY file asks users to comply with applicable law but adds no use-based restrictions beyond the license, so the release is open source.

license_evidence.scope: openai/gpt-oss-120b model weights, tokenizer, chat template, and original and Metal checkpoint artifacts

access_boundary: This record represents the openai/gpt-oss-120b weight release at Hugging Face commit b5c939de8f754692c1647ca79fbf85e8c1e70f8a, last modified 2025-08-26. The gpt-oss-20b sibling, downstream quantizations and fine-tunes, OpenAI's managed API services, and independent hosting providers remain separate boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI publishes Transformers-layout Safetensors, original checkpoint, and Metal artifacts in one ungated repository with a repository license file
The model card documents Transformers, vLLM, PyTorch/Triton, Ollama, LM Studio, and SGLang serving paths for self-operation
tradeoffs: The published MXFP4 checkpoint is sized for a single 80 GB accelerator, so self-operation still needs data-centre-class hardware
Neither the model card nor OpenAI's docs page carries dated release notes or a deprecation posture, so version identity rests on repository commits

flags.statement: We ran scalable capability evaluations on gpt-oss-120b, and confirmed that the default model does not reach our indicative thresholds for High capability in any of the three Tracked Categories of our Preparedness Framework (Biological and Chemical capability, Cyber capability, and AI Self-Improvement).
